newsitem.title: USA: Zonic says cash flow problems continue.
newsitem.headline: Zonic says cash flow problems continue.

text.p: Zonic Corp said on Tuesday that it continues to have cash flow problems, despite reporting earlier today that second quarter earnings had risen to $0.04 per share, up from a $0.03 per share loss in 1995.

The company said its total current liabilities "increased substantially" compared to the first quarter because certain bank loans that had previously been classified as long-term debt now will be maturing in the next 12 months.
The company said it is unable to improve materially on the aging of its accounts payable and certain other accrued liabilities.
